component: Dark-reader JavaScript and stylesheet preference gates

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The module's enabled check controls destructive inline/embedded-style adaptation, while messageBody.css uses the preference together with prefers-color-scheme: dark for page/header colors. Current CSS uses -moz-pref syntax and color-scheme:dark; those are later accepted refinements beyond the historical -moz-bool-pref gate. Changing only the JavaScript or only the CSS can leave the two parts inconsistent. The checked preference is now default true, unlike the original Nightly-only default.
title: Keep dark-reader DOM adaptation and stylesheet preference gates paired
